var{car:Yh,brake:Xh}=Pd,Zh=Yh.maxSpeedKmh/Nd,Qh=class{speed=0;distance=0;pedalForce=0;accel=0;powerCut=!1;holdTime=0;reset(){this.speed=0,this.distance=0,this.pedalForce=0,this.accel=0,this.powerCut=!1,this.holdTime=0}get speedKmh(){return this.speed*Nd}step(e,t){let n;if(this.powerCut)t?(this.holdTime+=e,this.pedalForce+=(Xh.rampBase+2*Xh.rampGrowth*this.holdTime)*e):(this.holdTime=0,this.pedalForce=Math.max(0,this.pedalForce-Xh.releaseRate*e)),n=-(Xh.rollingDecel+Xh.dragCoeff*this.speed*this.speed+Xh.decelPerNewton*this.pedalForce);else{let e=Math.min(this.speed/Zh,1);n=Yh.launchAccel*(1-e**+Yh.accelFalloffExp)}return this.accel=n,this.speed=Math.max(0,this.speed+n*e),this.distance+=this.speed*e,this.powerCut&&this.pedalForce>=Xh.breakForceN}},$h=3,eg=2.7,tg=.04,ng=class{phase=`menu`;dynamics=new Qh;brakeElapsed=0;v0Kmh=0;peakForce=0;countdown=0;lastCountdownTick=0;brakeStartDistance=0;earlyHintCooldown=0;samples=[];sampleTimer=0;start(){return this.dynamics.reset(),this.brakeElapsed=0,this.v0Kmh=0,this.peakForce=0,this.samples=[],this.sampleTimer=0,this.countdown=$h,this.lastCountdownTick=4,this.phase=`countdown`,[]}toMenu(){this.dynamics.reset(),this.phase=`menu`}get canBrake(){return this.phase===`accelerating`&&this.dynamics.speedKmh>=Pd.brake.minSpeedKmh}get distanceToBarrier(){return Pd.track.barrierDistance-eg-this.dynamics.distance}step(e,t){let n=[];switch(this.earlyHintCooldown=Math.max(0,this.earlyHintCooldown-e),this.phase){case`countdown`:{this.countdown-=e;let t=Math.ceil(this.countdown);t<this.lastCountdownTick&&t>0&&(this.lastCountdownTick=t,n.push({type:`countdown`,value:t})),this.countdown<=0&&(this.phase=`accelerating`,n.push({type:`start`}));break}case`accelerating`:if(t&&(this.canBrake?(this.phase=`braking`,this.dynamics.powerCut=!0,this.v0Kmh=this.dynamics.speedKmh,this.brakeStartDistance=this.dynamics.distance,this.recordSample(),n.push({type:`brake_start`,v0Kmh:this.v0Kmh})):this.earlyHintCooldown===0&&(this.earlyHintCooldown=1.2,n.push({type:`brake_too_early`}))),this.phase===`accelerating`){this.dynamics.step(e,!1),this.checkBarrier(n);break}this.stepBraking(e,t,n);break;case`braking`:this.stepBraking(e,t,n)}return n}stepBraking(e,t,n){let r=this.dynamics.step(e,t);if(this.brakeElapsed+=e,this.peakForce=Math.max(this.peakForce,this.dynamics.pedalForce),this.sampleTimer+=e,this.sampleTimer>=tg&&(this.sampleTimer-=tg,this.recordSample()),r)this.dynamics.pedalForce=Pd.brake.breakForceN,this.peakForce=Pd.brake.breakForceN,this.crash(`brake_snap`,n);else if(!this.checkBarrier(n)&&this.dynamics.speed<=Pd.brake.stopSpeed){this.dynamics.speed=0,this.phase=`stopped`;let e=this.result(!0);n.push({type:`stopped`,result:e})}}recordSample(){this.samples.push({t:this.brakeElapsed,speedKmh:this.dynamics.speedKmh,force:Math.min(this.dynamics.pedalForce,Pd.brake.breakForceN)})}checkBarrier(e){return this.distanceToBarrier>0?!1:(this.crash(`barrier`,e),!0)}crash(e,t){this.phase=`crashed`,t.push({type:`crash`,reason:e,result:this.result(!1,e)})}result(e,t){this.v0Kmh>0&&this.recordSample();let n=Math.round(this.brakeElapsed*1e3)/1e3,r=Math.round(this.v0Kmh*10)/10;return{success:e,reason:t,v0Kmh:r,stopSeconds:n,stopDistance:this.dynamics.distance-this.brakeStartDistance,peakForce:this.peakForce,score:e?Fd(r,n):0,samples:this.samples.slice()}}};
